# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in Otter Scaffold privately through GitHub:
**Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository. Please do not disclose them publicly
until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and fix them.

Include the affected version, how to reproduce the issue, and its impact. Pairing links, access
tokens, and heap snapshots are credentials; redact them from reports.

If the vulnerability is in code inherited from [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code),
report it to T3 Code as well, following its security policy.
